No Revisit dates have passed. The next one is bake-to-order on **2026-12-02**, nine days from now.

Your ledger rules out free trials, a free first box, delivery apps, a courier partner and walk-in stock. None of those reopen conditions has been met: you had 15 paid signups in October, and the free-trial condition needs fewer than 8 a month for two months. That leaves these four for the winter:

**1. Subscriber referrals with half off the first month (start here)**
You discarded 50% off the first month on 2026-10-06, but you set a reopen condition: test it with a referral from an existing subscriber. This would be that test. The new subscriber gets the first month at half price, and the subscriber who referred them gets a free loaf or pastry in their next box. A friend recommendation is a different kind of lead from the free-box crowd, where only 6 of 52 stayed. The 140 subscribers you already have are your cheapest channel. Track paid signups from referrals separately so you can judge the test by its own numbers.

**2. Christmas gift subscriptions**
Sell 4-week and 8-week boxes, paid upfront, with a printed card. Buyers pay full price, December is when people buy gifts, and some recipients will carry on paying when the gift runs out. The recipient has to live within your 3 km zone, so check the address at checkout.

**3. Winter specials as an add-on and a first step**
Offer 2–3 seasonal bakes, for example a spiced loaf or an enriched festive bread, as add-ons for subscribers and as one-off pre-orders for anyone else. This fits bake-to-order with the 6 pm cutoff, so you don't waste anything. Each one-off buyer gets a card in the bag inviting them to subscribe.

**4. Flyers on the streets you already ride**
Put door hangers on streets where you already deliver, saying something like "Your neighbours get warm bread on Saturday." More subscribers on the same streets means more boxes per ride, which matters because Saturday capacity is your limit. Printing a few hundred costs well under €100 of the €300 budget.

**Before any of this: how many open Saturday delivery slots do you have?** Saturday capacity is what limited the free-box test. If you're close to full, start with referrals and gift subscriptions, because they bring fewer sign-ups but ones more likely to keep paying.

If you go ahead with the referral test, I'll log it in the ledger as reopening the 50% off option under its stated condition.
